name: plotlibre-workspace
description: A MapLibre-native framework for parametric situation plotting and tactical graphics.

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/link-workspaces.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run playground:typecheck && npm run playground:build
scripts.playground:dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @plotlibre/playground
scripts.playground:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @plotlibre/playground -- --base /PlotLibre/
